# Usage Attestation

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:UsageAttestation`](gmeow-UsageAttestation.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/UsageAttestation>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/lexicon`](../../slices/lexicon.md)

An evidence node recording that a lexical form, reading, inscription, symbol, construction, or usage was observed in a source or context. Evidence, not truth: an attestation records that something was seen, not that a proposed interpretation is correct ([Principle 12](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-12)). Follows the [`LanguageState`](gmeow-LanguageState.md) / [`KinRelationship`](gmeow-KinRelationship.md) pattern as an [`Observation`](gmeow-Observation.md) + Relator. Mediates between an attested form, a source, a context, and optionally a time interval.

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:Observation`](gmeow-Observation.md), [`gufo:Relator`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-relator)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:UsageAttestation`](gmeow-UsageAttestation.md) as a specialized kind of [`gmeow:Observation`](gmeow-Observation.md), [`gufo:Relator`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-relator). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.
